Marta Silva: Heads-up  Candidate Camila Santos (Frontend SWE) is in So Paulo (BRT, GMT-3). She prefers 18:00-21:00 BRT (12:00-15:00 PT). Wants a remote pairing interview (VS Code Live Share) first, then an optional short onsite whiteboard + office tour if screening passes. She mentioned limited bandwidth and asked if audio-only + screenshots of whiteboard prompts is OK. Also requested access to a private lactation room while onsite and motorcycle parking since she commutes by bike. Can people-ops handle badge prereg + lactation room reservation?
Rob Huang: 12:00-15:00 PT window works for the panel. Plan: 3 x 45m pairing + 30m debrief. For pairing, we'll include a small bugfix task in Live Share ~30m. If bandwidth is an issue we'll switch to audio + share snippets; thumbs up?
Priya Desai: We can reserve the lactation room (Room L2) and printed badge. Motorcycle drop and short-term slot available; parking code `MOTO-GUEST-1` for curb access. Need candidate full name as on ID, email, and phone to prereg. Lactation room access policy: guests may use for up to 90m with prior notice.
Marta Silva: Camila details: camila.santos.candidate@example.com; passport name Camila Oliveira Santos; phone +55 11 91234 5678. She asked about loaner laptop (Mac) in case Live Share fails.
people-ops-bot: Accommodation note: lactation rooms are reserved through office-ops@redwood.com; please allow 24h to confirm. Loaner device requests via asset-requests@redwood.com (24h notice). Bandwidth fallback: add "audio-only + whiteboard screenshots" to calendar invites. Reimbursement: local transit under BRL 200 (approx) submit receipts to expenses@redwood.com. Internal links: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/accommodations and https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/reimbursements
Priya Desai: I'll prereg the badge and reserve Room L2 for 16:00-17:30 PT (quiet room adjacent to reception) in case she comes onsite. I'll also flag motorcycle parking and place a printed badge at reception.
Rob Huang: Suggest we build a short checklist for interviewers: enable Live Share but have an audio backup, don't rely on video, and save whiteboard screenshots for candidate review. Also please include lactation room + parking notes in invite.
Marta Silva: Draft calendar copy (please paste into invites): ```Remote pairing (VS Code Live Share) 12:00-14:15 PT: 3 x 45m pairing interviews + 30m debrief. NOTE: candidate has limited bandwidth; please be prepared to run audio-only and share whiteboard screenshots. Optional onsite tour 16:00-17:00 PT (Room L2 lactation room reserved; printed badge at reception; motorcycle parking code: MOTO-GUEST-1). Contact on arrival: Priya Desai +1 650-555-0177.```
Priya Desai: Reserved Room L2 and added lactation room note. Badge prereg done; printed badge will be at reception at 15:30. I put a motorcycle hang-tag next to the badge. Loaner Mac hold: pending asset request by EOD before interview.
Marta Silva: Candidate confirmed remote slot and appreciated the lactation room note. She said she'll decide about onsite after the second pairing.
Rob Huang: Action items: Marta confirm loaner if candidate requests; Priya confirm asset hold and badge pickup; Interviewers add bandwidth fallback plan.
people-ops-bot: Note added to candidate profile: "Camila Santos - hybrid; limited bandwidth; lactation room requested; motorcycle parking; loaner Mac hold pending; reimbursement guidance sent."
